basic_profile.bio: Living in Halifax, I'm a university student majoring in Computer Science. I recently discovered the world of Reddit and have been exploring various communities. My interests include technology, gaming, and online content creators. I also have a soft spot for exclusive content and reviews, which led me to some niche subreddits. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time online, mostly in the evenings after classes or on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of computer science principles gained through my university coursework. I enjoy learning through online forums and reviews, especially regarding new technologies and gadgets.
